content: Offline-first local-only RN apps converge on: (1) a persistence layer (SQLite) reachable only through typed repositories holding all SQL; (2) pure service layer for business logic with dependencies injected (no React, no DB client) so it is unit-testable; (3) thin view models (Zustand stores or hooks) per feature slice; (4) file-based routes as thin screens. Local-first canonical references: Ink & Switch local-first software essay; WatermelonDB/PowerSync docs all enforce repository/repository-pattern separation and sync-engine-free local schema with the UI reading only from the local DB. BabyLog docs/04 folder architecture already matches this feature-slice + core/ + repository pattern.
